subject: Runtime capacity allocation: proposed slate and comp-band ask
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runtime capacity allocation: proposed slate and comp-band ask

Team —

We reviewed Q3 throughput forecasts and the production tail latency work (benchmark report attached). Growth in demand for cold-start-heavy workloads pushes us to provision two additional runtime infra slots this quarter to meet our SLOs without increasing burst capacity spend. Proposal attached: "proposed-runtime-slate.pdf" (high level role descriptions + preferred start windows) and "capacity-forecast-2028Q3.xlsx".

Ask: approval to open two headcount lines in the runtime infra group (one Sr. Runtime Engineer, one Runtime Infrastructure Engineer) and greenlight to extend offers within the attached comp bands. Estimated incremental run-rate is in the spreadsheet — net impact within the existing infra hiring envelope if we reprioritize one mid-level SWE hire from Platform into Runtime for Q3.

Key reasoning (short):
- Measurable user latency reduction vs current config (see sheet)
- Avoids a large burst reservation purchase in Sep by smoothing hires across July-Aug
- Positions team to finish KV-cache / continuous-batching infra work this year

Next steps I propose:
1) Finance signoff on reallocation and comp bands
2) HR (Soji[n]) to confirm offer bands and recruiting plan
3) If greenlit, I'll instruct Talent to surface top candidates (we already have two in pipeline)

Tagged items: JIRA HRREQ-1427, Drive folder link in metadata for details.

—
Jordan Blake
Director, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity allocation: proposed slate and comp-band ask

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. I reviewed the forecast — the latency gains look convincing and moving two slots into runtime is reasonable if we can keep the net headcount steady this quarter. Two quick asks before I sign off:

1) Can you model an alternative with 1 senior + 1 mid instead of Sr + Jr? I think a senior/mid pair might hit the roadmap faster and reduce ramp risk; cost delta should be small but we need clarity.
2) Confirm whether the mid-level can be a reallocation from Platform (you mentioned reprioritization). We need a firm commit to avoid double-counting the budget.

If those check out, I'm prepared to approve the reallocation and comp-band ranges.

Marcus
VP, Engineering

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity allocation: proposed slate and comp-band ask

Jordan / Marcus —

I pulled the current comp bands and attached "comp-bands-2028.pdf". High level: the Sr. Runtime slot maps to Band 6 (senior IC) and the mid-level maps to Band 4/5 depending on specialization. We can do 1 senior + 1 mid within the same overall budget envelope if Marcus is comfortable with reallocation details.

Hiring ops notes:
- If you want to fast-track an offer, Talent can present an internal referral or engaged candidate within 1 week; external sourced offers will take ~3 weeks to close on average.
- Approvals needed from Finance (Laura) and People Ops for requisition creation.
- Please provide target ranges per role (min/target/max) and we will prepare offer templates and pre-approve the bands with compensation committee.

I flagged HRREQ-1427 for requisition setup once we get budget signoff.

—
Soojin Lee
Head of People Ops

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity allocation: proposed slate and comp-band ask

Marcus / Jordan —

Reviewed the updated forecast and Soojin's note. Finance will approve the reallocation on the condition that net headcount for the infra org does not exceed the Q3 plan. If you convert one platform mid-level slot into the runtime mid-level (as described), we're good — please mark the original Platform req as deprioritized in Workday/Greenhouse to avoid overlap.

Budget note: Approving 1 Sr (Band 6) + 1 Mid (Band 4/5) fits the hiring envelope for this quarter with a small contingency. We ask that any sign-on credit or relocation above standard policy be routed through me for additional approval.

Approved pending: confirmation that platform-to-runtime reallocation is executed and the requisitions are updated.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance — Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Nix Talent <recruiting@nixstaffing.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity allocation: proposed slate and comp-band ask

All —

Thanks — I'll proceed with the 1 Sr (Band 6) + 1 Mid (Band 4/5) plan. Action items:
- Soojin: please open requisition HRREQ-1427 and prepare offer templates with the ranges from comp-bands-2028.pdf. Target ranges: Sr Band 6 (140000-190000), Mid Band 4/5 (110000-150000).
- Marcus: I'll mark the Platform mid-level req as deprioritized in Greenhouse this afternoon.
- Laura: if there are any policy-level approvals needed for sign-on, I'll route through you.
- Nix Talent: please surface any engaged candidates who match the Sr runtime profile; we have a warm lead (Priya Rao) and one referral (Rafael Mendes) in the folder.

I'll post a quick sync calendar for Monday to align interview panels and target offer windows (aiming to close by July 10).

Thanks —
Jordan
